caption: The drawing depicts a single piece of clothing, specifically a dress with a fitted bodice and a wide, full skirt. The dress is outlined in black lines on a light, off-white or beige background. The bodice has stylized seam lines and a zigzag collar, and ends just above the waist where a layer of fine, vertical lines indicates a fringe detail. The skirt is large and bell-shaped, with several vertical lines suggesting folds or pleats. The overall composition centers the dress on the paper with no additional objects or background details. There are no colors apart from the black linework and the neutral color of the paper.
title: Dress Pattern
